messages:
incident-bot: ALERT ▶ realtime-latency-regression detected: service=inference-main env=prod metric=p99=3.4s (>2.0s). paging on-call.

maya: taking the page, joining now. quick triage: is this only /v1/stream?

alex: opening Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/services/inference-main?from=now-20m - /v1/stream p99 spike ~3m ago. /v1/complete looks normal.

sre-tilly: I'm on. pulling node and pod health. any customer reports? @cust-success-jordan

cust-success-jordan: support note: one customer reported "stream stalls then reconnect" ~12m ago. not widespread so far.

charles: quick Loki filter: {app="inference", route="/v1/stream"} |= "kv_cache_miss" | count_over_time(5m) -> sharp increase. also seeing many connection resets.

sandra: streaming uses session-affinity. any affinity or routing changes in last hour?

alex: no routing rollouts. there was a kvcache-service canary ~4h ago, completed. affinity still enforced.

charles: node metrics: r-euw1-2 shows elevated GPU memory usage and host OOM_kill events on the gpu daemon. two pods OOMed.

sre-tilly: mitigation plan (quick):
1) Cordon r-euw1-2 so scheduler won't place new pods.
2) Disable session affinity for new streaming sessions so traffic can rebalance.
3) Scale up streaming pool in healthy racks.
4) Pre-warm KV for hottest prefixes to reduce miss storm.
5) Apply temporary concurrent-stream limit per tenant if needed.

sandra: executing commands now:
```
# cordon bad node
redwoodctl node cordon r-euw1-2
# disable affinity for new sessions
redwoodctl routing update --service inference-main --route /v1/stream --affinity=none --apply
# scale streaming pool
redwoodctl pool scale streaming-pool --replicas +3 --region eu-west-1
# kick off prewarm job
/scripts/prewarm_kv.py --top-prefixes 100
```
Commands run at 1798136880, 1798136895, 1798136910, 1798136920 respectively.

alex: watching metrics: p99 for /v1/stream fell from 3.4s -> ~1.1s within ~6m after routing/scale actions. p95 down to ~230ms.

charles: some long-lived sessions still seeing tail >5s because of reconnect/backlog; backlog draining as pods reschedule.

maya: customer message sent: "We detected streaming stalls and have rerouted traffic and warmed caches. Performance improving; monitoring closely. We'll follow up with details." :thumbsup:

cust-success-jordan: customer acknowledged, will keep us posted.

sre-tilly: follow-ups (post-triage): create incident ticket for eng-runtime, add alerts: kv_cache_miss rate >5/min, node GPU OOM spike; add canary test simulating prefix churn. recommend investigation into kvcache eviction/regression and affinity behavior.

sandra: created ticket INC-2026-4820 assigned eng-runtime. link: https://tickets.redwood/INC-2026-4820

maya: we'll watch for 30m. leaving channel open for oncall handoff. handing to next oncall after monitoring.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity=sev2, status=stabilizing, incident-ticket=INC-2026-4820, pages=[oncall].
